purpose: Calibrate when dual-expert evidence is supported and stable, then accumulate causal evidence without treating unknown as normal.

allowed: DROID accepted training episodes for independently initialized or episode-bootstrap dual experts
DROID held-out calibration episodes for absolute support, ensemble disagreement and likelihood-ratio gates
synthetic response scales 0.25, 0.50 and 0.75 derived only from DROID calibration responses
forbidden: reward, success, disturbance-active flag, object state or simulator contact oracle as runtime inputs

reliability.support_statistic: empirical percentile of max(log p_normal, log p_abnormal) against pooled source calibration
reliability.stability_statistic: one minus empirical percentile of across-ensemble likelihood-ratio standard deviation
reliability.sensor_quality: minimum of timestamp, finite-value, EEF-jump and joint-speed validity checks
reliability.low_reliability_behavior: unknown/abstain; never convert directly to normal evidence

acceptance_checks_before_target_test: at least three independent ensemble members
normal gate strictly below abnormal gate
calibration artifact marked source_only with input hashes
isolated source-normal spikes do not trigger sustained alarms
persistent unknown is surfaced as protective observation
all runtime and leakage tests pass

evaluation.reporting_rule: Report coverage and unknown rate together with accuracy; never improve apparent accuracy by abstaining silently.
